name: hbsguard
description: Standalone, read-only Handlebars linter for Node.js projects, with configurable rules, a recommended preset, custom configurations, and a CLI built on the plain Handlebars AST.

paragraphs: hbsguard is a standalone Handlebars linter built around plain Handlebars AST semantics. Linting is read-only by default, with optional fixes for three whitespace rules. It provides a generic recommended preset and supports project-specific configurations without coupling the published package to any one repository.

Use the browser Playground to edit preloaded violations, switch presets, and inspect live diagnostics without installing anything. Apply whitespace fixes demonstrates the same fix engine in the editor, with Undo fix and Reset example available. The button confirms ✓ Fixes applied after success and shows No automatic fixes when only manual work remains. Editing the source or configuration checks fix availability again. The demo never writes files or uploads your template.
